# Abyssale

Abyssale is a creative automation platform that enables users to generate images, videos, GIFs, PDFs, and HTML5 content programmatically, streamlining visual content production.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/abyssale/.

## Actions

- **Create Abyssale Project**: Create a new project to organize designs and images.
- **Get Designs** (read-only): Retrieve all designs with optional filtering by category or type.
- **Get Fonts** (read-only): List all available fonts, including custom and google fonts.
- **Test Abyssale Authentication** (read-only): Test api authentication via the /ready endpoint.
